S.FORM: == Voyʉe Toskʉ == Voyʉe Toskʉ (kowaping ngangan: Du Xiaosheng；Dipong ngangan: Badosurei Hideo, 1922-2001 miheca 3 folad), o nai Alisan Cou finacadan niyaro' masofoc a ising ato sician tamdaw. o malikakaay i ina a ontosia ci Uongu Yatauyogana a Cou tamdaw. 'Oripan Kaemangan a 'orip Tona ikor a matolo' mapatay ko mama ni Uongu Yatauyogana i, miliyaw ci fa'inay ta sofocan ci Voyʉe Toskʉ. I 1942 miheca 3 folad, misawad nai Taynansu a Taynan sakacecay no ciukakko ci Voyʉe Toskʉ itiya; saka tosa miheca 4 folad, ciniala cingra to Tayhoku teikoku daykaku Senmon iriyoho a pitilid. I1945 miheca, misawad ci Voyʉe Toskʉ nai Tayhoku teikoku daykaku Senmon iriyoho haw i, mala o saikoray milayapay to sa'elinay Ikaku kiwiku no yincumin . Ikor no lalood ato kohecalay katalawan I 1951 miheca, maala ci Voyʉe Toskʉ to sarakatay saka 1 liyad no Ciayisien iing. Ikor i, mala''a'isidan no Wufongsiang isisio ci Voyʉe Toskʉ, ta matahidang ni Uongu Yatauyogana cikapi tayal a citodongay i Sinmi a sadatengan. I 1954 miheca, ca Uongu Yatauyogana, Yapasuyongʉ Yulunana aci Losing Watan a kakeridan no Cou ato Tayal finacadan mapakokot pakaciraraw to mifelihay a mapatay; pisetekan mipatay toya romi'ad, maparoma haca ko pipakokot to "Ca Yapasuyongʉ Yulunana mifelihay ato mikelotay a kaciraraw" a caay to ko kakoksoen sa ko hoyin, nika ci Voyʉe Toskʉ mapakokot pararaw to pikihatiya a marofo , ikor no 4 miheca itiya to a mapasadak. Nawhani o makahinapecan itiya to pisinting ato kohecalay katalawan, saka hakelongen ni Voyʉe Toskʉ ko fafahi ato wawa malinah tayra i Ciayi Tapo , Yinlin Pikang. I 1976 miheca, mapatay ko fafahi ni Voyʉe Toskʉ ci Du Ruilian, nanoya tangsol sa miliyas to Tapo, tayra i Poli Kristokiw isingan matayal. Ikor i, cifafahi ci Voyʉe Toskʉ to Paiwan finacadan fafahiyan ci Gao Meiying a kangkoho, nanoya malinah paloma' i Taytong Taimali Cinlon patireng to isingan. I 1995 miheca, misingsi patiyol to kacingangan to Voyʉe Toskʉ. I 2001 miheca 3 folad, ci adada to kahira adada no tireng ci Voyʉe Toskʉ a mapatay . Laloma'an O fafahi ni Voyʉe Toskʉ to nano Cou wawa ni Du Ruilian, ciramod cangra ira ko 6 wawa to fa'inayan fafahiyan; oya ci Du Mingzhe masofoc i kasadakan ta malinah tayra i Tapo ko sofoc. I kalaloodan ho nao Dipong a Sekicuci a kankoho itiya. Minengneng Demak ni Tang Yingshen Pinengnengan to tilid
